At the end of my first three months I had stronger lashes than I did pre-pregnancy, o had MORE, and they were long and beautiful (almost to my brow arch). 

This is one product I will not go without. I’ve been using it consistently for the last 15 years so you could say I’m a loyal customer. I tell everyone who asks about my lashes what I use because we all deserve to feel pretty as naturally as possible.
